name: X-Ray
description: Amazon-style X-Ray for movies and shows: who is in the current scene (faces, plus voices for cartoons and costumed characters) and the song that is playing.
overview: Who is on screen, and what is playing.

versions.changelog:
First public release.
- Who is in the current scene: faces, plus voices for cartoons and costumed characters, named automatically.
- People stay in scene across camera cuts.
- Music from your Jellyfin music library (optional AudD).
- Runs on Linux x64, Raspberry Pi 4/5 (64-bit OS), Windows and Apple Silicon Macs. Needs Jellyfin 12.3+ and File Transformation.
